name: Engelhardt Hall
use: Small traditional residence hall, 111 students; Lower Quad; alcohol- and drug-free hall ('Ehardt')

facts.text: Dedicated June 14, 1947 and named for Fred Engelhardt, UNH president 1937-1944, who oversaw Pettee Hall's construction and the Field House's completion.
Built 1946; one of the three Lower Quad halls with Engelhardt, Gibbs and Hunter.
Hall of 111 students at 12 Quad Way; alcohol- and drug-free hall ('Ehardt').
Amenities listed are a kitchen, laundry, indoor bike storage and WiFi; no air conditioning or elevator is listed. Accessibility: limited-use bathroom on the 1st floor.

verdict: Small 1946 Lower Quad hall in tidy brick with a dormered top floor; no A/C or elevator, but the quads are liked.
notes: No renovation history found for the Lower Quad halls. Old row credited Eric T. Huddleston as architect; no source I opened confirms it, so architect is left null. notunh's map spells it 'Englehardt'; the archives and Housing spell it 'Engelhardt', so the notunh name should be corrected. No licensed photo found. Reference photo 02 (UNH Housing) shows the Lower Quad in autumn: two-storey red-brick halls with white dormered upper storeys and white entry porticoes around a lawn with mature trees.
judgeNotes: Reference photos show plain postwar colonial brick.
